title: Improved Villager Trading
description: Improves the villager GUI and speeds up trading
body:
![you can reorder the villagers trades and use the Max button to complete the selected trade as many times as possible](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/70cba1deafb3ff8b06171667c114cc2c54e6606a_0.webp)Allows players to "Favorite" villager trades to make them appear at the top of the list, aswell as a search button to find trades.

Also adds a "max" button to complete a trade as many times as possible
